findings.title: port 22 reachable from the public internet
findings.proves: TCP connect to 80.241.209.34:22 succeeded from this host.
findings.does_not_prove: Not proof of compromise. Only proof of reachability; authentication strength is assessed separately.
findings.remediation: Bind to 127.0.0.1 or restrict with a firewall rule.

findings.title: sshd accepts root password authentication (effective config)
findings.proves: `sshd -T` reports permitrootlogin=yes and passwordauthentication=yes. This is the EFFECTIVE config after drop-ins, which override the main file.
findings.does_not_prove: Does not prove an account was compromised. Check auth logs for successful logins from unexpected source addresses.
findings.remediation: Delete the drop-in that re-enables it; verify with `sshd -T`; then `sshd -t && systemctl reload ssh`.

harness_limitation: This harness probes from the host itself. A local connect to the public address may traverse hairpin NAT and does not prove an off-site host's view. UNVERIFIED entries mean genuinely unknown, not closed.
